integrity: Proof is analytic; standalone numerical test is a reproducibility aid, not an infinite verification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed regular planar normal fan, one interior angular sample per cone, fixed dimension and independent C_c^1 angular offsets positive near midsector; unconstrained linear support-parameter inverse, not a convexity-constrained estimator. The probability-tail constant is an exact surface integral. The prior equal-midsector hexagon ambiguity is expressly credited; historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Parity-sharp inverse instability in one-per-sector support sampling of regular-fan polygons
